concerns.text: Tasks T031-T035 (Computational Universe/Rule-based generative model) have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. The spec explicitly focuses on Random Forest and ILR transformation. These tasks represent unauthorized scope creep with no traceable requirement anchor.

Tasks T009a (Materials Project) and T009b (NIST) implement FR-001, but the plan.md and tasks.md logic (T016/T017) lack a defined task to MERGE these three distinct sources (MP, NIST, OpenML) into a single unified dataset before filtering. Without a 'Merge Sources' task, the pipeline cannot satisfy FR-002 (single filtered dataset) or SC-001 (completeness against all sources).

Task T014 implements a 'HALT' strategy for missing `measurement_method` data. While this addresses FR-009, it conflicts with the multi-source ingestion strategy in T009a/b/c. If one source lacks the field, the pipeline halts entirely, preventing the extraction of valid data from other sources. A task to 'Log and Exclude' (per spec Edge Cases) rather than 'Halt' is missing for the multi-source context.

Task T021 implements the 80/20 split (FR-005) but lacks a task to ensure STRATIFIED sampling for compositional data. A random split on atomic fractions (summing to 1.0) risks creating training/test sets with disjoint chemical spaces, invalidating SC-002 (MAE against held-out set). A 'Stratified Split' task is missing.

Success Criterion SC-006 requires 'measuring' data independence. Task T014 only implements binary filtering (Keep/Exclude). There is no task to 'Quantify and Log' the count of excluded derived entries vs. kept independent entries to satisfy the 'measured against' requirement of SC-006.

Task T009c targets OpenML ID 42347, but lacks a distinct pre-flight task to verify the schema/content of this specific ID against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` before extraction, as required by the plan's 'Verified Accuracy' principle. The current task assumes validity.
